Current & Recent:

Shelby completed the British American Drama Academy’s Midsummer in Oxford program in July 2026, playing Hero, Balthasar and Sexton in Much Ado About Nothing under Ben Naylor. Her credits also include a guest role on PLL: The Perfectionists and Nettie in The Color Purple with Chromolume Theatre.

Meet Shelby Williams!

Shelby Williams is a Los Angeles-based actor and mezzo-soprano working across film, television, theatre and commercial. She studied on-camera acting and scene study at Monet Studios, completed the Meisner Certificate Program at The Taylor Acting School, and trained in the Alexander Technique and at Margie Haber Studio.

She earned a B.A. in Economics from Reed College, where she performed in Citizen: An American Lyric and And I and Silence. Outside of acting she writes songs, produces music, plays violin, viola and cello, and dances in styles from hip hop to ballet.
